messages.subject: normTrainingAndTestSet
messages.body_plain:
Hi there,

First of all, thanks a ton for this package. I am using it in my master's thesis (properly cited) and it is so helpful!

Just a minor issue I came across when learning how to use it.

The documentation of "normTrainingAndTestSet" says:

"[...] The inputsTrain member is normalized using normalizeData with the parameters given in type. [...] if dontNormTargets is not set, then the targets are normalized in the same way.[...]"

However, the default attribute is: dontNormTargets = TRUE

This issue doesn't get in the way of using the program, but delays the understanding a little bit, so I thought it would be helpful to give this feedback.

Best Regards,

Hermes
